cases.title: S4 37-element lattice DRAGON/SERPENT k-effective cross-check

outputs.calibration_method: minimax midpoint of the two printed k-effective values

comparisons.evidence: reported printed value with published statistical sigma

cases.interpretation: The midpoint minimizes the maximum absolute distance to the two published method outputs. It does not reproduce either solver and no physical tolerance is selected.

cases.interpretation: The independently computed energy balance is 9.59139 GWd/t versus the reported rounded 9.6 GWd/t. The difference is reported, not converted into a tolerance or used to change runtime physics.
